incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: INC-9831 · High
incidentbot: Service: inference-embedder-prod
incidentbot: Symptom: 5xx spike > 30s across embeddings endpoint; initial alert rate ~18% (us-west)

erica: ack — oncall Erica here, taking ownership. /pd ack INC-9831 :thumbsup:

mike: looking at grafana -> us-west embedder pods showing ~95% GPU util, queue backlog increasing. Possible KVCACHE thrash.

jia: joining bridge. opened runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedder-5xx
jia: quick checks:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/embeddings/health | jq '.'
# observed: svc_errors=18% request_rate=120/s
```

erica: handoff to Jia for mitigation/bridge lead. I’ll take customer-facing comms and monitor SLOs. stepping back in ~10m.

jia: initiating mitigation: 1) scale dedicated pool +2 nodes, 2) flush prefix/KV cache for embedder-v2, 3) rolling restart worker set.

deploybot: Deploybot: rolling restart initiated by jia — change abc123 — rolling 6 pods — ETA ~4m

mike: autoscale and cache flush acknowledged. provisioning temporary fallback model (smaller embedder) in case error rate rebounds.

jia: post-restart check: 5xx rate down from ~18% -> 1.2% over last 60s. queue backlog shrinking.

erica: customer impact: limited to a subset of customers running large batch embed jobs; errors were transient, retries succeeded, no data loss. drafting PSA now.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: INC-9831 acknowledged by erica, incident in stable window; resolve if 10m continuous below threshold.

jia: will keep bridge open for 20m then close and file postmortem. assigning follow-up to eng-runtime for KVCACHE eviction tuning.

mike: noted — created follow-up ticket and linked dashboards.

erica: thanks team — great quick response. :raising_hand: I'll publish incident summary and runbook updates after bridge close.
